statement: In the setting of Proposition 6.1, suppose that Ω contains a fixed neighborhood of B1 ⊂ Π. Let σi be positive measures supported on density-Q points of Vi in the ambient closed unit ball, with c ≤ σi(B1) ≤ C, σi(Br(X)) ≤ Crs (X ∈ Rm+n , r > 0), s > m − 1. Pass to a weak limit σ along the subsequence defining the linearized measures. Then σ ̸= 0, its support lies in B1 ⊂ Π, and it has the same upper ball bound. There is l∗ > 0 such that 2l2 Z ϕx,l dm ≥ Z ψx,l dν (x ∈ spt σ, 0 < l < l∗). (7.2)
